title: Pithyx catalog maintainers v1
description: `apps/<id>/maintainers.json` on `master` of a catalog repository (D328): the GitHub accounts that may update the app. A pull request that changes an app must come from one of them, as the file stood before the pull request; a new app's file must name its author. The catalog's owner reviews every pull request and may change the file.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

items.description: A GitHub login, compared without regard to case.
